cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Feelings and describing words; each picture shows one clear feeling or quality, opposites (big/small, noisy/quiet) look clearly different.

words.en: Lily is happy on her birthday.
words.scene: Lily at the table with a birthday cake with candles, a big happy smile, Tom clapping beside her and Max under the table.
more: Tom is happy to see Grandma.
Tom 见到奶奶很高兴。
We are very happy in the garden.
我们在花园里很开心。

words.en: Tom is unhappy about the rain.
words.sz: Tom 因为下雨很不开心。
words.scene: Tom unhappy because rain stops the football game.
more: Tom is unhappy when he loses his toy.
Tom 的玩具不见了，他很不开心。
Don't be unhappy. I'll help you.
别难过，我来帮你。

words.scene: Lily frowning with her hands on her hips as Max runs off with her homework book in his mouth, Tom laughing on the sofa.
more: Dad is not angry, only tired.
爸爸没有生气，只是累了。
Don't be angry with your little brother.
别生你弟弟的气。

words.en: Tom is afraid of the storm.
words.scene: Tom crouching behind the sofa with his hands over his ears and his eyes shut tight, scared, not smiling, lightning flashing in the dark window, Mum reaching out to him.
more: Max is afraid of loud noises.
Max 害怕大声的噪音。
Are you afraid of the dark?
你怕黑吗？

words.en: Tom is brave at the dentist.
words.sz: Tom 在牙医那里很勇敢。
words.scene: Tom sitting in a big dentist's chair holding the arms of the chair tightly, his mouth open for the dentist, his eyes a little scared but his chin up, a grown-up man dentist with a small mirror.
more: Lily is brave in the deep water.
Lily 在深水里很勇敢。
Be brave, Tom. You can do it!
勇敢点，Tom。你能行！

words.scene: Mum standing at a rainy window at dusk, both hands on her cheeks, eyebrows up, her face worried and not smiling, looking out at the dark wet street.
more: Grandma is worried when Tom is late.
Tom 回来晚了，奶奶很担心。
Don't be worried. Lily is safe at Mia's.
别担心，Lily 在 Mia 家很安全。

words.en: Lily is excited about the trip.
words.sz: Lily 对这次出行很兴奋。
words.scene: Lily jumping up and down with a present.
more: Sam is excited about the football match.
Sam 对那场足球比赛很兴奋。
The class is excited about the school trip.
全班同学对学校郊游很兴奋。

words.en: Tom is bored when it rains.
words.scene: Tom lying on the sofa on his back, arms hanging down, eyes half-closed, looking very bored, not smiling, rain running down the window, toys lying unused on the floor.
more: Tom is bored, so he draws a picture.
Tom 觉得无聊，就画了一幅画。
Are you bored? Let's play a game!
你无聊吗？我们玩个游戏吧！

words.scene: Dad asleep on the sofa in front of a boring programme on TV.
more: The long wait is very boring.
漫长的等待很无聊。
Maths is not boring at our school.
在我们学校，数学一点也不无聊。

words.scene: Lily looking closely at a beetle with a magnifying glass.
more: Mia is interested in birds, too.
Mia 也对鸟感兴趣。
Tom is interested in every fish in the lake.
Tom 对湖里的每一条鱼都感兴趣。

words.scene: Lily reading a book, eyes wide.
more: Grandpa tells interesting stories.
爷爷讲有趣的故事。
Max does interesting things in the park.
Max 在公园里做有趣的事。
Tom is tired but not unhappy.
Tom 累了，但并没有不高兴。
Are you tired? Sit down with Mum.
你累了吗？和妈妈坐一会儿吧。
Lily feels hungry after swimming.
Lily 游完泳觉得饿。
Are you hungry? Have a sandwich.
你饿了吗？吃个三明治吧。

words.sz: Tom 向 Lily 说对不起。
words.scene: Tom with his head down and sad eyes, not smiling, holding out a broken toy robot to Lily, who looks upset; one arm of the robot is on the floor.
more: I'm sorry, Lily. I broke your toy.
对不起，Lily。我弄坏了你的玩具。
Dad is sorry: the cake is not ready.
爸爸很难过：蛋糕还没好。

words.scene: Tom finding a four-leaf clover in the grass.
more: We are lucky: the sun is out.
我们真幸运：太阳出来了。
Grandpa feels lucky in his new house.
爷爷在他的新家里感到很幸运。

words.en: Mum is busy in the kitchen.
words.scene: Mum cooking, on the phone and holding the baby at once.
more: Dad is busy at work today.
爸爸今天工作很忙。
The shop is very busy on Saturday.
这家商店星期六很忙。

words.scene: Lily carrying a full glass of water very slowly.
more: Careful, Tom! That water is hot.
小心，Tom！那水很烫。
Lily is careful with her little brother.
Lily 带着小弟弟很小心。

words.en: Lily reads alone in her room.
words.sz: Lily 独自在房间里读书。
words.scene: Lily reading happily alone in a quiet room.
more: Tom walks to school alone, and he is happy.
Tom 独自走路上学，他很开心。
Grandma likes to sit alone in the garden.
奶奶喜欢独自坐在花园里。

words.en: Tom is able to swim now.
words.scene: Tom swimming on his own for the first time, Dad clapping.
more: Lily is able to read very well.
Lily 能读得很好。
Are you able to ride a bike alone?
你能独自骑自行车吗？

words.scene: Lily at the door with her coat and school bag on.
more: Are you ready? Let's go!
你准备好了吗？我们走吧！
Tom puts on his coat. He is ready.
Tom 穿上外套，他准备好了。

words.scene: Max sitting up straight and smiling in front of Mum, who is giving him a dog biscuit, Tom clapping beside them.
more: Grandma's soup is very good.
奶奶的汤很好喝。
Be good on the bus, Tom!
坐公交车时要乖哦，Tom！

words.en: Max, that is a bad idea!
words.scene: Max lying on the kitchen floor with one chewed shoe in his mouth, his head down, looking guilty, Mum holding the other shoe.
more: What bad weather!
多糟糕的天气！
Don't be bad, Tom! Say sorry.
Tom，别调皮！说对不起。

words.scene: Tom sitting up in bed and smiling, a mug of warm milk on his bedside table, Mum opening the curtains so the morning sun comes in.
more: Mum is better after her rest.
妈妈休息以后好多了。
Tom runs better now.
Tom 现在跑得好多了。

words.scene: Lily smiling and waving hello with one arm up, standing in the sunny kitchen with her school bag on her back.
more: It's fine today, so we can play in the park.
今天天气晴朗，我们可以去公园玩。
Are you fine, Tom?
Tom，你没事吧？

words.scene: Sam sitting on a garden bench giving a big thumbs up and grinning, Max at his feet.
more: Grandpa tells great stories.
爷爷讲的故事很棒。
It's a great day for football.
今天是踢球的好日子。

words.en: It's nice to see you, Mia!
words.scene: Mia smiling and giving Lily a sweet at the school gate, their bags on the ground, Max sitting between them.
more: Tom has a nice new bike.
Tom 有一辆很棒的新自行车。
Grandma's garden is a nice place.
奶奶的花园是个让人愉快的地方。

words.scene: Grandma in her garden leaning over a patch of pink flowers, her eyes closed, smelling them with a happy smile, a watering can on the grass.
more: What a lovely day!
多美好的一天！
Mia's jumper is lovely.
Mia 的毛衣真好看。

words.scene: A calm sunny afternoon in the park: Lily, Tom, Mum and Dad sitting on a red and white blanket under a big tree, a basket and two cups beside them, Max asleep on the grass.
more: We had a pleasant walk by the lake.
我们沿着湖边走了一段，很愉快。
Grandma tells us pleasant stories.
奶奶给我们讲令人愉快的故事。

words.scene: Lily and Tom side by side in the garden at night, watching colourful fireworks high in the dark sky, their mouths open.
more: Lily's painting is amazing!
Lily 的画真了不起！
Look at that amazing picture!
看那张令人惊奇的图片！

words.scene: Tom running with his arms up after kicking a football into a small goal, Mum and Dad clapping at the side, Max running after him.
more: Max has a brilliant idea!
Max 想出了一个绝妙的主意！
Our project is brilliant.
我们的项目棒极了。

words.scene: A smiling teacher putting a gold star sticker on Lily's drawing at a classroom table, Lily proud, Tom looking at his own paper beside her.
more: Excellent work, Lily!
Lily，你做得真好！
Tom is excellent at football.
Tom 足球踢得特别棒。

words.scene: Sam wearing sunglasses, standing on his skateboard on a sunny pavement, his T-shirt blowing in a light wind.
more: That's a cool skateboard!
那滑板真酷！
Cool! I like your sunglasses.
真酷！我喜欢你的太阳镜。

words.scene: A terrible storm outside at night, seen from inside the warm house: wind bending the trees, rain on the window, Lily and Tom at the window with Mum safe behind them.
more: The traffic is terrible today.
今天交通糟透了。
What terrible weather!
天气真糟糕！

words.sz: 绿色是我最喜欢的颜色。
words.scene: Lily hugging her old brown teddy bear tight and smiling, sitting on her bed with it, her red boots and a book about dogs beside her, all her other toys left on the shelf.
more: What's your favourite food?
你最喜欢的食物是什么？
This is my favourite book.
这是我最喜欢的书。

words.scene: One big birthday cake with five lit candles in the middle of the table, Lily and Tom looking at it, Mum bringing in the plates.
more: It's a special birthday present.
这是一份特别的生日礼物。
Lily's red coat is special to her.
Lily 的红外套对她来说很特别。

words.scene: Lily and Tom standing in the garden in the daytime, looking up at one strange cloud in the blue sky shaped like a big fish.
more: Tom sees a strange bird in the garden.
Tom 在花园里看见一只奇怪的鸟。
Max hears a strange noise at night.
Max 晚上听到一个奇怪的声音。

words.sz: Tom 做了个搞笑的鬼脸。
words.scene: Tom pulling a funny face with his tongue out and his eyes wide, Lily laughing with both hands up on the grass beside him.
more: This film is very funny.
这部电影真好笑。
Grandpa's hat looks funny.
爷爷的帽子看起来很有趣。

words.sz: Lily 对 Tom 很善良。
words.scene: Lily helping an old woman carry her bags along the pavement, both smiling, Max walking beside them.
more: That woman is very kind.
那位女士非常善良。
What kind of music do you like?
你喜欢哪种音乐？
senses: What kind of music do you like?

words.sz: Lily 对每个人都很友好。
more: Max is friendly to every dog.
Max 对每只狗都很友善。
Tom is friendly at the new school.
Tom 在新学校很友善。
Lily is clever with puzzles.
Lily 很会拼图。
Tom has a clever answer.
Tom 有一个聪明的回答。

words.scene: One very big brown dog sitting on the grass next to little Max the puppy, the big dog's head as high as Dad's waist.
more: Max is a big dog now.
Max 现在是一只大狗了。
This box is too big for the car.
这个箱子太大，装不进汽车。

words.scene: A tiny grey kitten sitting in Lily's two hands, small enough to fit there, Lily looking down and smiling.
more: Max's bed is too small for him.
Max 的床对他来说太小了。
These shoes are small, and Tom can't wear them.
这双鞋很小，Tom 穿不了。

words.scene: Dad standing straight next to little Tom on the grass, Dad much taller than Tom, both smiling at the child.
more: A tall tree is next to our house.
我们家旁边有一棵高高的树。
Tom wants to be tall like Dad.
Tom 想像爸爸一样高。

words.scene: One red and yellow kite high up in a blue sky with white clouds, the string going down to Lily's hands at the bottom of the picture.
more: That mountain is very high.
那座山很高。
Lily puts the cup on a high shelf.
Lily 把杯子放到很高的架子上。

words.scene: Dad lifting a big heavy box with both hands, his face red with the effort, Lily and Tom watching and trying to help.
more: Sam's school bag is heavy every day.
Sam 的书包每天都很重。
This bag is too heavy for Mum.
这个袋子太重了，妈妈提不动。

words.scene: Tom hugging a big soft teddy bear on his bed, his cheek pressed into it, eyes closed happily.
more: Max's fur is soft.
Max 的毛很软。
Grandma makes a soft blanket for Tom.
奶奶给 Tom 织了一条柔软的毯子。

words.scene: Tom trying to bite a very hard bread roll, holding it with both hands and pushing it against his teeth, his face red.
more: This question is hard for Tom.
这个问题对 Tom 来说很难。
Lily works hard at school.
Lily 在学校学习很努力。

words.scene: A long silver train speeding past on the rails, its wheels a blur, Lily and Tom on the other side of the fence waving and watching.
more: Max runs fast in the garden.
Max 在花园里跑得很快。
Tom swims fast now.
Tom 现在游泳很快。
senses: Max runs fast in the garden.

words.en: Be quick, Tom! The bus is coming.
words.scene: Lily running to catch the bus at the bus stop, her school bag behind her, one arm up, the bus already moving in front of her.
more: We had a quick game in the park.
我们在公园里快速玩了一场。
Mum asks for a quick answer.
妈妈想要一个快速的回答。

words.scene: One brown snail moving slowly across a big green leaf, its body stretched out, Lily watching it close up.
more: Tom is slow, but he tries hard.
Tom 动作慢，但他很努力。
Grandpa's bike is too slow.
爷爷的自行车太慢了。

words.scene: Tom banging a big red drum with two sticks in the sitting-room, Max barking beside him, Lily, Mum and Dad all covering their ears.
more: The class is noisy today.
今天班上很吵。
It is noisy in the shop.
商店里很吵。

words.scene: A quiet library with tall bookcases, Lily sitting on the floor reading a book on her own, one finger on her lips.
more: Be quiet, Tom. Grandma is resting.
小声点，Tom。奶奶在休息。
Mum likes the quiet garden.
妈妈喜欢安静的花园。

words.scene: Grandpa's very old small brown car with its old wheels parked next to Dad's shiny new blue car in the driveway, Grandpa by the old car's door.
more: That old tree is tall.
那棵老树很高。
I don't like these old shoes.
我不喜欢这些旧鞋。

words.scene: A young puppy standing next to its big mother dog in the grass, the puppy looking up at her.
more: The young cats are small.
那些幼小的小猫很小。
All the young children play here.
所有年幼的孩子都在这里玩。

words.scene: A shiny modern kitchen with long white cupboards, a flat top and a tall fridge, Mum and Lily at the table with a cake.
more: Our school is big and modern.
我们的学校又大又现代化。
They live in a modern flat.
他们住在一套现代化的公寓里。

words.scene: A beautiful sunset over the sea, the sky orange and pink, the low sun making a bright path on the water, Lily and Tom on the sand watching it with Max.
more: Lily's picture is beautiful.
Lily 的画真美。
What a beautiful garden!
多美丽的花园啊！

words.sz: Mia 的连衣裙非常漂亮。
words.scene: Mia standing in a pretty dress with small flowers all over it, holding out the skirt so it opens wide, smiling, Lily clapping beside her.
more: Tom picks pretty flowers for Mum.
Tom 给妈妈摘漂亮的花。
What a pretty bird!
多漂亮的一只鸟啊！

words.sz: 对啦！那个答案是正确的。
words.scene: The teacher putting a big red tick on Lily's answer, Lily smiling.
more: Tom gets the right answer.
Tom 答对了。
Lily knows she is right.
Lily 知道自己是对的。

words.en: Tom puts on the wrong shoes.
more: Oh no, my answer is wrong.
哦不，我的答案是错的。
Max goes the wrong way in the park.
Max 在公园里走错了路。

words.en: My bag is different from Tom's.
words.sz: 我的包和 Tom 的不一样。
words.scene: One red apple in a line of green apples.
more: Lily and Mia are different, but good friends.
Lily 和 Mia 不一样，但她们是好朋友。
These two pictures are very different.
这两张图片很不一样。

words.en: This puzzle is difficult for Tom.
words.sz: 这个拼图对 Tom 来说很难。
words.scene: Lily frowning at a hard puzzle.
more: Maths is not difficult at our school.
数学在我们学校不难。
It is difficult to carry this box.
搬这个箱子很困难。

words.en: The water in the lake is clear.
words.scene: A clear blue lake where you can see the fish.
more: The sky is clear tonight.
今晚天空晴朗。
Lily asks a clear question.
Lily 问了一个清楚的问题。

words.en: This is a real dog, not a toy.
words.sz: 这是一只真的狗，不是玩具。
words.scene: A real brown dog with a wet nose sitting next to a small stuffed toy dog of the same colour on a rug, the real dog sniffing the toy.
more: Lily wants a real pet, not a toy.
Lily 想要一只真的宠物，不是玩具。
Is that a real bird in the tree?
树上那是一只真的鸟吗？

words.scene: Lily putting her hand up high in the classroom, smiling and looking sure of the answer, her book open in front of her, Mia nodding beside her.
more: I'm sure Max is behind the door.
我肯定 Max 在门后面。
Lily is sure she can do it.
Lily 确信自己能做好。

words.scene: Lily fast asleep in her bed in a dark, quiet bedroom, her teddy beside her, the moon and stars outside the window, Max asleep on the rug at the foot of the bed.
more: Breakfast is important every day.
每天的早餐很重要。
It is important to help your friends.
帮助朋友很重要。

words.en: An umbrella is useful in the rain.
words.sz: 下雨时有一把伞很有用。
words.scene: An umbrella keeping Lily dry in the rain.
more: This book is useful for Lily's maths.
这本书对 Lily 的数学很有用。
Tom finds an old box very useful.
Tom 觉得一个旧盒子很有用。

words.scene: A famous singer on stage, many fans cheering.
more: Sam wants to be a famous player.
Sam 想成为一名著名的运动员。
Our town has a famous old bridge.
我们镇上有一座著名的旧桥。

words.en: Dad is free on Sunday afternoon.
words.scene: Dad lying in a hammock on a free afternoon.
more: Mum has a free morning today.
今天上午妈妈有空。
The bus to the park is free.
坐公交车去公园是免费的。

words.en: The man in the big house is rich.
words.sz: 住在大房子里的那个人很富有。
words.scene: A man in a smart suit next to a huge house with a swimming pool.
more: The rich man has a big car.
那个富有的人有一辆大汽车。
Grandpa is not rich, but he is happy.
爷爷不富有，但他很快乐。

words.sz: 可怜的 Max！他全身都湿了。
words.scene: Max wet and shivering, Lily drying him with a towel.
more: The poor cat is warm at Grandma's house.
那只可怜的猫在奶奶家暖暖的。
Grandma gives food to poor people.
奶奶给贫穷的人送食物。

words.scene: Dad lifting Tom high above his head.
more: Tom's legs are strong after his bike ride.
骑完车，Tom 的腿很有力气。
Max has strong teeth.
Max 有很结实的牙齿。
Can I have one sweet, please?
请给我一颗糖好吗？
Mum puts a sweet in Tom's lunch box.
妈妈在 Tom 的午餐盒里放了一颗糖。

words.sz: 妈妈和爸爸已经结婚了。
more: Kate's sister is married now.
Kate 的姐姐现在结婚了。
Grandma and Grandpa got married a long time ago.
爷爷奶奶很久以前就结婚了。

words.en: Grandma is well, and we are happy.
words.sz: 奶奶身体很好，我们很开心。
words.scene: Lily feeling well and happy, carrying a small shopping bag up the garden steps with a big smile, Max running around her legs, bright sunshine.
more: Tom doesn't feel well today.
Tom 今天感觉不舒服。
Lily draws very well.
Lily 画画画得很好。
